mapper.select: SELECT summary_dt , summary , sentiment , article_count , created_at , updated_at FROM market_summary ORDER BY summary_dt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id , title , source , url , published_at FROM news_article WHERE published_at >= DATE_SUB(#{summaryDt}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND published_at < DATE_ADD(#{summaryDt}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 5
